retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus, atmospheric layout featuring a large ethereal background portrait overlaid with a row of sharp, framed character headshots and classic serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition where a hazy, high-key portrait serves as a textural background for a structured row of three rectangular character portraits at the bottom, unified by a warm, sepia-toned color palette and formal serif type.
coreVisualRelationships: Large ethereal background portrait vs. small sharp foreground frames
Warm gold and orange typography against muted neutral tones
Horizontal alignment of character portraits at the lower third
Soft atmospheric haze contrasting with crisp typographic edges
coreInvariants: Soft-focus background portrait with high transparency or low contrast
Three distinct rectangular portrait frames aligned horizontally
Warm-toned serif typography for titles and credits

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale face in the background (top right/center); three small-scale portraits in the lower foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central row of three framed portraits acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large title top-left, moves down the left-side text, across the three portraits, and ends at the bottom metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of soft, hazy negative space in the upper right quadrant to allow the background portrait to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted beige and soft grey (background haze)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights in the background; typography provides the only saturated color hits.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a heavy, italicized serif with swash-like extensions
Secondary text uses a clean, high-contrast transitional serif
Metadata uses a wide-tracked, all-caps slab or heavy serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking 'D' and 'M' in the main title
Extended tails on 'g' and 'y' to create a sense of motion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Decorative display script paired with a clean, functional serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Thin orange borders around character portraits

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the period-appropriate high-contrast serif feel.
Provides the necessary weight and swash potential for the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, high-key portrait of an elderly woman in a sun hat, using a muted beige and grey palette. Include three small, sharp, rectangular portrait frames at the bottom, each containing a different character headshot with a thin orange border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stylized gold serif title in the top left. Add a block of burnt-orange serif text below the title. Place all-caps black serif names centered under each of the three bottom frames.

verificationChecks: Is the background portrait sufficiently soft and ethereal?
Are the three bottom portraits aligned and framed with thin borders?
Is the title typography gold with a slight drop shadow?
Is the secondary text a warm burnt-orange color?

adjustableVariables: Number of character frames at the bottom

avoid: Harsh digital sharpening on the background
Clashing cool tones like neon blue

postGenerationChecks: Check that the background does not obscure the legibility of the orange text.
Ensure the three bottom frames are perfectly level.
Verify the gold gradient in the title feels metallic rather than flat yellow.
Confirm the overall mood is nostalgic and cinematic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus background + Triptych foreground frames + High-contrast serif typography = Period Cinematic Aesthetic
